_readme: Blind stage pass 2026-09-04 (COLLECTION.md §4): each keyed row judged from the production evidence (scratch/evidence-pack.json render + parametric memory, web on triggers), the key out of context, then scored. Same-session caveat as every run: the session that wrote the key ran the pass; honesty = a document-anchored key and a judgment that cites the evidence pack, not the key.
